summary: Parked-car kerb beside apartment blocks 13-15 m away.

best_section.where: West kerb of Riverview Terrace just south of the shop car park entrance

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 13-15 m away on the same side, more across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; parked cars line the kerb, so room is tight but usable.
drivers.traffic: Through street beside shops and cinema; lively by day.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb; mixed time-limited and no-stopping signs.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs nearby
sun_shade: Street trees on the east side shade the kerb in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Cinema and shop noise at night
